scope: Already-completed, user-requested dashboard FEATURE+UX review: four perspectives, three actual rounds, Standard design-only. This is consolidation, not another app/code review or implementation approval.
review_result: Three rounds complete; majority roadmap with preserved 3-to-1 N1-versus-N2 sequencing dissent. All implementation actions remain proposed/unbuilt.
method: Four perspectives independently inspected product source and labelled browser evidence in Round 1, challenged named peers in Round 2, and revised or defended priorities in Round 3. A technical-writer role consolidated those records and the N1 plan gate without another product/host survey. Consolidation verified instructions, the prior audit reference and CI entry points; it ran no live actions or test suites.

runtime_continuity.round_one: Four independent persona contexts; default synchronous dispatch, with operations automatically backgrounded.
runtime_continuity.between_rounds_one_and_two: The attempted multi-recipient follow-up delivered no messages because three synchronous contexts could not accept it. Those three were explicitly rotated to replacement background contexts using the common four-persona Round 1 record; operations retained its context.
runtime_continuity.rounds_two_and_three: Named cross-critiques used common records. Round 3 reused the four Round 2 contexts.
runtime_continuity.voting_limit: Four perspectives, not seven independent votes or twelve independent reviewers. Later rounds are revisions, not extra votes. No human-participant or model-diversity claim.

visual_baseline.limit: Actual narrow/desktop views and labelled fictional scenarios are distinct. Scenarios are not observed real workload operations; no screenshot contents are republished.

evidence.existing_controls: Separately field-proven in the earlier actions audit using disposable native fixtures, including Cancel, container controls and retained volumes. That evidence was recorded before this review and was not rerun here.
evidence.adjudication_limit: UX observations and recorded code-derived focus/retry concerns are design hypotheses, not newly reproduced physical-phone failures. Proposed receipts, exact reads and future features have no implementation proof from these captures.
evidence.command_verification: The supplied record resolved the harness handoff against CI and the unittest entry point. This consolidation also read CI lines 44-49; it did not rerun the suites.

seed_legend.F05: Workload recovery, later narrowed to Start

positions.position: Find the intended app, stop it, understand the outcome and recover without a terminal. Long scrolling, small target links and disconnected details/observations impede that job. Bounded container CPU/RAM and logs follow a trustworthy control loop; broad scans, bulk control and longer retention wait.

Improve hierarchy and target identity; address refresh-replaced interactive nodes, accessible dialog naming/focus and disconnected unknown/paused outcomes. Prefer immediate reconciliation over extensive history. Start is narrower than Restart and cannot undo Remove; bounded logs precede broad collection.

Separate command outcome, later target state and application health. Reuse bounded journal evidence plus an exact-target observation, never sampled-list disappearance. Initially favored Start second, navigation with existing attention signals, logs before broad attribution, and deferred broad storage scanning while exposing cached age/coverage.

Initially bundled minimal shortcuts and action reconciliation, then Start for one existing container. Logs versus metrics remained uncertain; recurring storage pressure could elevate bounded storage explanation. Sorting a CPU-limited sample by RAM would not establish a true memory ranking.

consolidated_report.decision: Recommend N1 reach-and-understand feedback, then N2 known-measurement provenance/policy, N3 existing-container Start, N5 bounded manual target logs and N4 bounded CPU/RAM diagnosis. This is a majority recommendation, not unanimous sequencing or authorization.
consolidated_report.parallel: Minimal phone section jumps, readable rows, touch targets and focus continuity are independent parallel work: neither prerequisite nor replacement for outcome checks.

rugged_plan.meaning: Readiness of the proposed N1 validation plan only; not feature, implementation or physical-phone proof.

actions.job: Reach one existing container Stop and understand the available command evidence and separately observed state.
includes: One existing single-container Stop journey with Docker/current-user Podman parity and unchanged authority, confirmation and protection policy; no new mutation type.

Carry engine plus immutable full container ID through the action and separately sequenced exact read. Only an exact read ordered after the attempt in server/transport execution can supply the newer observation; page generation or client/server clock comparisons cannot.
Only actual server journal records with real action IDs are receipts. If response/action ID is lost, preserve an unlinked browser attempt; never invent a receipt or correlate by name/time.

Keep command outcome, current observed running/stopped/absent/unknown state and application health separate. Exact not-found means absent, not stopped; a later state does not establish command causation.

Reuse existing journal/rotation: proposed maximum 20 actual records from a bounded 64 KiB tail, with truncation, unavailable history and missing terminal evidence explicit. Outside-window records remain unknown.

Typed exact-target read reusing the shared total-deadline Unix helper with a proposed 2-second budget; explicit read-only Check state, named dialog, safe/retained/return focus, announced results, duplicate-confirm prevention and inert Cancel.
excludes: Start/Restart, other mutation families, root authority, automatic mutation replay, sampled-inventory absence as proof, invented receipts or name/time linkage.
Navigation redesign, fleet-health scoring, metrics database, expanded retention, generic shell/proxy, filesystem scans, deletion controls, new authentication or stack.
Sampled-inventory fallback, automatic disruptive retry or an unbounded/background exact-read retry loop.
phone_journey: Reach the workload section directly or through an independently delivered section jump; find a readable engine/identity-labelled existing target row.
Open the target and its Stop confirmation; preserve the immutable identity and safe focus through refresh. Confirm once, or Cancel without dispatch.
Read the actual linked receipt if its action ID is available; otherwise see an explicitly unlinked uncertain attempt.
Read a separately ordered exact-target observation, or use read-only Check state after failure. Unknown may remain even when a later state is visible; paused stays paused.
Return focus to the target row, or its section heading if the row is gone, without retrying the mutation.
actions.validation: Future P1-P4 below; none implemented or run in this review.

actions.job: Explain known storage measurements and policy, not a complete disk breakdown.
actions.includes: Show each existing source, measurement age, scope/coverage and separately dated filesystem availability; distinguish measurements, estimates and supported reclaimability from protected/deferred work and the last actual cleanup. Missing data is unknown, not zero.
actions.excludes: Unexplained sums of overlapping sources, complete-attribution claims, unsupported reclaim promises, new scans/collection loops or deletion controls.
actions.validation: Future N2_provenance_not_reclaimability, N2_missing_and_recovery and N2_no_extra_io: mixed-age/overlapping data remains separate, missing coverage stays unknown, later records update only supported facts, and the panel adds no scan or mutation.

actions.job: Start only one existing stopped Docker/current-user Podman container within existing authority, with parity and exact-target protections.
actions.excludes: Root controls, pull, create, enable, process launching, user-unit Start and Restart initially. Start cannot recover a removed container.

actions.job: Manually read one bounded target-specific diagnostic log excerpt.
actions.bounds: Proposed 100-200 lines plus byte/time caps; explicit truncation and unavailable states. No follow mode, global log browser or retained copy.

actions.job: Bounded on-demand CPU/RAM diagnosis, after logs.
actions.bounds: Distinguish selected-container diagnosis from true whole-host rankings. RAM sorting of the CPU top sample is not a full memory ranking; high CPU alone may be healthy work. No broad attribution system or expanded metrics retention.

actions.job: Independently deliver minimal phone section jumps, readable target rows, touch targets and focus continuity.
actions.boundary: Parallel, not prerequisite or substitute for N1 outcome checks; no navigation redesign or forced bundling.

actions.job: Decide whether to authorize implementation and choose N1-first or the reasonable cheaper N2-first alternative.
actions.boundary: The completed review grants no implementation consent; deferred options are not approved scope.

actions.job: On an actual LAN phone, verify the implemented journey using only a disposable target prepared by the agent: open the existing bookmark, inspect identity, Cancel, confirm Stop once, reconnect and inspect the receipt or uncertainty with a read-only recheck.
actions.boundary: No owner-side terminal or new login step. Persistent data and unrelated targets remain untouched. If no physical phone is available, retain that explicit delivery-verification gap rather than equating a narrow browser with hardware proof.

validation_design.status: Future case extensions/probes only: not implemented, not run and not already-passing feature evidence.
validation_design.origin: Extend existing offline fake-Unix-peer/HTTP/action and actual-app VM harnesses; no host engine sockets or real workloads. A future narrow-browser fixture intercepts all mutation POSTs.
validation_design.handoff_resolution: Dedicated commands were verified, not rerun. The supplied record also verifies CollectorTests at tests/dashboard-smoke.py:27. The product/PM generic invocation is rejected; no new suite success is claimed.

cases.command: python3 -B tests/dashboard-actions-smoke.py && python3 -B tests/dashboard-smoke.py && node --test tests/dashboard-ui-smoke.cjs
cases.assert: Only the original engine/full-ID exact read sequenced after the attempt supplies the newer observation. A newer page, stale snapshot, capped-list disappearance, clock skew or same-name replacement cannot verify it. Exact not-found is absent, not stopped.
cases.recovery: Restore exact reads and update only observed state without replay; command causality and app health remain separate.

cases.assert: Initial audit failure sends nothing. Post-dispatch audit/response loss remains uncertain even if the target is later stopped. Only actual journal records are receipts; a lost action ID leaves the browser attempt unlinked.
cases.recovery: Restore audit/transport and reread the exact original identity; retain uncertainty and never infer linkage, causality or automatic resend.

cases.assert: Progressing headers/body still hit the total deadline and release the worker. History respects the 64 KiB/20-record bounds. Attempts visibly settle; paused manual-read failure never resumes polling or promises retry. Duplicate confirmation dispatches once; Cancel dispatches zero.
cases.recovery: The next explicit read may succeed after peer recovery without mutation replay, history rewrite, focus theft or target loss.

cases.probe: Future 390x844 Chromium fixture: open exact target, tab into confirmation, wait through refresh, cancel, reopen and inspect outcome; repeat paused manual-read failure and Escape. Fictional identities and intercepted mutation POSTs only.
cases.assert: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth; dialog has a nonempty accessible name; focus stays safely inside across refresh; visible dialog controls are at least 44px in both dimensions; uncertainty is announced. Cancel attempts zero mutation requests; return focus reaches the row or section heading.
cases.recovery: Failed reads retain context and do not steal focus or resume polling. This future browser probe is not a physical-phone test.

dissent.priority: 3-to-1 remains: operator, frontend and product prefer N1 first because existing mutation uncertainty has immediate consequences; operations prefers N2 first because bounded provenance/policy serves recurring disk pressure cheaply without a collection loop.
dissent.disposition: Preserved, not averaged or resolved. N1 is the majority recommendation; operations' N2-first is a reasonable cheaper alternative for the future operator decision.
dissent.actual_convergence: All four final responses place N3 third, keep minimal navigation parallel and prefer N5 bounded logs before N4 CPU/RAM. Product's Round 2 logs/metrics uncertainty changed in Round 3; it is not remaining final dissent.
